topbar.trazCriativo: brings the Creative into the conversation
topbar.iniciarIdeacaoTitulo: Brings the Creative in to lead this session's ideation — it hasn't joined yet
topbar.ajustesAria: Model, response language and budget for this session
topbar.perguntaDeIdiomaPendente: there is a question about the response language

criativa.texto: This is a creative session. The Creative leads the ideation: it asks questions about the product and records the business rules that come out of the conversation. It doesn't decide on technology or write code — that's for the Architect and the devs, later on.
criativa.iniciarIdeacaoNota: It hasn't joined yet — this click is what brings it in.
criativa.exemploIntro: Start by telling us what you want to build and for whom. For example:
criativa.exemplo: I want an API that responds with a greeting to whoever calls it. It's for me to validate the end-to-end flow.
criativa.rodape: When the rules are complete, use I'm ready to build — that's what generates the brief and hands the ball to the PO.

consultiva.texto: Here you talk to an agent you choose: ask questions, get context, clear up doubts. No agent joins on its own — choose who answers in the field below the conversation. The Creative doesn't join, and this session won't go to execution.
consultiva.rodape: When it's time to build, open a creative session in the project's Sessions tab — the type is chosen at creation and doesn't change afterward.

composer.placeholder: Write a message… (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.prontoParaProduzir: I'm ready — the need is validated
composer.prontoParaProduzirExplica: Closes readiness and the need validation, and calls the PO: it joins on its own once the Creative finishes the product brief
composer.prontoParaProduzirDesabilitado: Capture at least one business rule with the Creative before confirming readiness
composer.confirmarArquiteturaDesabilitado: Promote at least one story in the Backlog before confirming the architecture
composer.destinatarioPrecisaEscolher: There is more than one agent in this session: choose who the message goes to.
composer.semAgente: This session has no agent yet: choose one and click Call. The offer shows up in the conversation, and the message can only be sent after you accept it.

ativacao.reabrirExplicacao: Reopening brings the session back to active with everything it already had: the conversation, the business rules, the answered questions and the offers between agents. The previous closing stays on record.
ativacao.reabrirExigeDeveloper: Reopening the session requires the developer role in this workspace.

mensagens.respostaVazia: Empty response — event from an older version, when turn failures were recorded as a blank response. The real reason wasn't recorded.
mensagens.modeloNaoGravado: This response was recorded without the model's name
mensagens.tetoDeIteracoes: Stopped at the limit of {{max}} steps without finishing the turn. What was recorded so far is above; tell me how you'd like to continue.

handoff.aceiteAutomatico: Accepted automatically: the backlog covers all {{regras}} business rules and the repository is local, so {{agente}} joined without a click.
handoff.aceiteAutomaticoFalhou: The automatic accept of the handoff to {{agente}} failed: {{erro}}. Accept it from the offer card.
handoff.semRepositorio: No repository yet: accepting this handoff provisions it, and only then can execution be activated.
handoff.infraDetalhe: Accepting activates the Infra Lead and already authorizes starting the container: in a Container or Mounted folder project with the Architect's routing ready, it picks the image and starts the container without another click. Starting it in a Local runner project and merging the infra PR still wait for your decision.
handoff.foraDaJanelaDetalhe: This offer's event has already left the last 200 in the thread, so its button lives here.

toasts.sessaoEncerrada: This session was closed and no longer accepts messages. Start a new session to continue.
toasts.prontoRegistrado: Need validated. The PO joins once the product brief is ready
toasts.erroModoAutomatico: Could not turn on automatic mode
toasts.levandoAExecucao: Taking you to the execution session.

modal.motivoDica: Goes as a pinned message in the PO's session. Say what's missing — that's what it uses to rewrite the story.
modal.motivoPlaceholder: E.g.: the acceptance criteria don't cover payment refusal.

aside.teto: This panel reads the {{lidos}} events already loaded for this session. There are {{anteriores}} older ones — “Load older”, in the Event log, brings more, and the other sections grow along with it.
aside.nadaNaJanela: None in the loaded events — there may be some in the earlier ones.
aside.artefatosVazio: No PR or backlog item in this session yet.
aside.eventoCitadoNaoEncontrado: The cited event wasn't found in this session.
aside.erroCarregarLog: Could not load the event log.

pendencias.titulo: Pending decisions from other sessions in this project
pendencias.nota: A shortcut to the decision: the same cards and endpoints as the Approvals tab. No ceiling changes — merging into a protected branch stays manual.
pendencias.recorte: Showing {{mostradas}} of {{total}} — the rest are in the Approvals tab.
pendencias.semPapel: Deciding here needs the developer role on the project. You can see the item, but someone else decides.

motivoNaoLido.todas_one: The policy reason for this card could not be read: reading the log of the session that proposed the action failed.
motivoNaoLido.todas_other: The policy reason for these {{count}} cards could not be read: reading the log of the session that proposed the actions failed.
motivoNaoLido.algumas_one: The policy reason for {{count}} of the {{total}} cards below could not be read: reading the log of the session that proposed the action failed.
motivoNaoLido.algumas_other: The policy reason for {{count}} of the {{total}} cards below could not be read: reading the log of the session that proposed the actions failed.

mergearNoChat.semPapel: Merging here needs the developer role on the project.
mergearNoChat.nota: Proposes the merge in this session; you confirm it on the card that appears — merging stays manual.
mergearNoChat.gatePendente: The {{gate}} gate is still pending for this PR. Merging stays available — the decision is yours.

fila.naFila: queued for {{agente}} — read when the current turn ends
fila.cancelada: cancelled in the queue — no agent read it
fila.cancelarSoAutor: Only the person who sent the message can cancel it.
fila.enfileirada: {{agente}} is mid-turn: the message joined its queue (position {{posicao}}) and will be read when the turn ends.
